goals: Verify that a movie is successfully created and all fields are saved in the database when valid data is provided.
Verify that a movie creation event is properly published when a movie is created by a normal or admin user.
Verify that the system returns a 400 Bad Request when attempting to create a movie with invalid or missing required attributes.
activities: Initialize WebTestClient and ScenarioExecutor with the server base URL and data source
Build a movie creation request with invalid name data
Log in as a normal user
Attempt to create a movie with the invalid request and verify a 400 return code
Build a valid movie creation request
Verify no events exist in the system
Log in as a normal user
Create a movie with the valid request and verify a 200 return code
Assert that the movie creation response and movie ID are not null
Retrieve the movie from the database and verify all fields match the creation request

Verify no events exist in the system

Assert that the movie creation response and movie ID are not null
Retrieve the movie from the database and verify all fields match the creation request
